worldcombat.skill.destinybond.summary: Openly ties a thread of fate to yourself: for a short while, whoever personally brings you down is dragged down with you. It does not shield you - it only puts the cost of the killing blow on the table. Using it while a bond is already armed fails.
worldcombat.skill.destinybond.use.0: Turn the finishing blow into the foe's own price while low
worldcombat.skill.destinybond.use.1: Force a foe to hold back and buy a breath or a retreat
worldcombat.skill.destinybond.use.2: Take the enemy's main threat down with you
worldcombat.skill.destinybond.descriptio: The armed bond stays on you for %1$s; during that time any non-ally blow that truly brings you down is dragged down too.
Tying it takes %1$s, with a %2$s cooldown. It neither reduces damage nor shields you; it only puts the cost on the table.
worldcombat.skill.destinybond.tight.0: Tight knot: a longer bond, but you are rooted on the spot the whole time and the cooldown is longer.
worldcombat.skill.destinybond.tight.1: Loose knot: a shorter bond, but you keep your footing and the cooldown is shorter - and it loosens sooner.
worldcombat.skill.destinybond.timing: Cast on yourself: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s and the cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.destinybond.preference: On: bond duration x1.5, rooted throughout, cooldown x1.2. Off (Loose): duration x0.7, free movement, cooldown x0.85. Trade how long the thread holds for whether you can still walk.
The partner ties the bond only below this health ratio; larger puts the cost on the table sooner, smaller keeps it for the last moment.
The partner considers the bond only while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee, larger chases out to arm.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to tie the bond.
